items.title: Push the ScummVM fork branch so the submodule pointer is real
items.default: not pushed: the branches diverged, so a push would be a force-push (see detail)
items.detail:
Phase 0 lists this; the pushed branch is ~20 commits behind the local submodule checkout.

Not pushed, needs your answer: the local rosetattoo-hires-mod (5c6aa645) and the fork's (90f9671e) have diverged. Local is the same 22 Sherlock commits rebased onto ~180 newer upstream commits (engines/sherlock identical), so pushing would be a force-push that removes 90f9671e, the commit this repository's submodule pointer records. The newer engine work is on ~20 codex/* and terra/* branches stacked above it in the submodule's GitButler workspace, not on rosetattoo-hires-mod.

Done 2026-11-14: pushed local rosetattoo-hires-mod (5c6aa645) to the fork as rosetattoo-hires-mod-rebased (one `git push` of that commit to a new ref; `but push` cannot rename). The fork's rosetattoo-hires-mod (90f9671e, pinned by this repo) is unchanged. The engine work on the codex/* and terra/* branches is still unpublished.
